DATABASE_URL.description: Postgres connection string. Same database as testbench-api — provisioned there and shared, not reprovisioned here.

R2_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare R2 account ID for object storage.

OCR_API_KEY.description: Azure AI Services (Document Intelligence) subscription key, used for OCR.

AZURE_OCR_ENDPOINT.description: Azure AI Services resource endpoint, e.g. https://<resource>.cognitiveservices.azure.com/

AZURE_OCR_REGION.description: Azure region of the Cognitive Services resource, e.g. southafricanorth.

GROQ_API_KEY.description: API key for Groq-hosted LLM inference.

VISION_LLM_API_KEY.description: Azure AI Services subscription key for cloud vision/image analysis (same resource as OCR_API_KEY).

CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD.description: Minimum confidence score (0-1) required to accept an extraction result without flagging for review.
